stewart_read: Bill captured cleanly but the rep's flip attempt was thin — 'quite expensive' plus a generic 'we can help' rather than reframing the $600 as the customer's real cost of staying with the utility.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep could be deliberately keeping tone low-key to match the customer's flat energy per coaching_philosophy.energy_match, but there's no evidence this was a calculated match rather than a missed flip.
coaching_implication: Should have tied the $600 explicitly to what solar eliminates before moving to the credit qualifier line.

stewart_read: New homeowner with a brand-new roof (also 8 months old) is an ideal long-tenure, no-reroof-needed profile, but rep treats it as small talk only.
coaching_implication: Could have used long expected tenure as a value point ('you'll get the full life of the system') instead of just noting it's exciting.

quote: I'm not looking for that right now.
stewart_read: First touch of bill-collection resistance; rep asks directly to pull it up rather than reframing why it matters or offering to book the appointment first and collect bill via specialist.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may be reactively trying the direct ask because customer just said no, planning to fall back to text if it fails again — this reads as sequential, not strategic.
coaching_implication: Should pivot to booking the appointment now and mention specialist will collect the bill on-site, per organic_lead guidance, rather than stalling the whole call on this ask.

stewart_read: Second refusal on the same bill-collection ask; rep immediately concedes to text-later without proposing a time to reconnect or an appointment.
coaching_implication: This was the moment to pivot to 'let's get you on the calendar with our specialist and they can grab the bill together' — instead the call ends without any date or time.

quote: Okay. I'll send that text right now, and then we will keep in touch.
stewart_read: Call ends with no appointment date/time, no button-up elements, and no verbal handshake — a fully unanchored close.
coaching_implication: Rep needed to lock a specific callback time or appointment slot before hanging up, even if the bill wasn't yet in hand.
